name: InferenceCostMath
summary: LLM serving-cost comparison math for Swift: API vs self-host parity throughput.
description:
Swift math for LLM serving-cost comparisons: metered API pricing vs
self-hosted throughput, blended input/output rates, and the parity
throughput where owning the GPUs starts winning per token. Pure
Foundation, no dependencies, Decimal throughout so cost audits do not
inherit floating-point drift. Built by the PastAGI team, which publishes
audited serving-cost math for LLM builders.
